messages:
Maya - Marketing: Quick check before I draft the release blog: need (1) final changelog URL (stable), (2) canonical docs link (no redirects), (3) webinar time + embargo, (4) UTMs for tracking. One-line replies please.

Diego - Eng: changelog: https://redwood-inference.dev/changelog/2026-06-12-release-final. No blockers. Canary window planned after deploy.

Priya - Docs: docs canonical: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/release/2026-06-12. I can publish a short how-to once Diego drops the tiny example (ETA 30m).

Sam - Growth: Webinar scheduled 12:30 PT (starts 12:35). Recommend embargo lift 12:30 PT. UTMs: utm_campaign=jun12_release & utm_source=webinar. For registrants add lead_tag=jun12_release.

Maya - Marketing: Thanks. Diego, can you confirm canary timeline if deploy starts at 09:00 PT? We need docs + blog live by embargo.

Diego - Eng: deploy plan: 09:00 deploy -> 09:00-09:20 canary -> 09:20-09:50 progressive rollout -> 10:00 full. Buffer ok for 12:30 embargo. Rollback plan ready.

Priya - Docs: once Diego posts snippet I'll merge and aim to publish by 11:15 PT. Leaves margin.

Diego - Eng: snippet (use exactly):
```js
// quick generate example for docs
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/latency-13b', prompt: 'Summarize the release notes', max_tokens: 100 });
console.log(out.text);
```
Canary tested it.

Sam - Growth: Landing modal copy suggestion: "Live demo: see Redwood's latency & cost gains. Join the release webinar." I'll push final modal with UTMs to #growth in 15m.

Maya - Marketing: Shorten to "Live demo: low-latency, cost-efficient LLM inference. Register." Sam drop final copy here when ready.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Diego at 6299998600. Artifact: artifact-2026-06-12.tgz. Canary + rollout configured.

Diego - Eng: ops note: if p95 > 3x baseline OR error spike > 0.7% during canary -> auto-rollback. Alerting to #eng-oncall.

Maya - Marketing: Perfect. Final publish plan if green: 12:30 PT blog + changelog + docs go live, 12:35 PT webinar starts, 12:40 PT social posts queue. Please react when you see this so I can treat thread as ground truth. :white_check_mark:
